score_type: raw video-text similarity logits; not probabilities
purpose: human review shortlist only; not ground truth or a rule decision

prompts.cash_count_without_customer: A bank employee counts or sorts banknotes at a service counter.
prompts.previous_cash_left_on_desk: Banknotes remain on a service counter while another customer approaches.
prompts.cash_handover_without_visible_receipt: A bank employee hands a paper receipt or document to a customer across a counter.
prompts.collection_bag_not_visibly_checked: A bank employee examines a cash collection bag and its seal at a counter.
prompts.counting_without_controller: One bank employee counts, sorts, or bundles banknotes while another employee supervises.
prompts.identity_document_presentation: A customer presents an identity document or a phone to a cashier at a counter.
